izzyondroid:com.mirfatif.mylocation.description:
Features: 
 My Location finds your device's location in the following ways:
 - GPS is usually the most accurate method. But a position fix may take some time or may not work at all due to signal loss. Lock GPS feature runs a persistent service to keep connected with the satellites.
 You can also see the list of visible satellites with their PRNs (unique identifiers) and SNR (signal quality).

izzyondroid:com.trianguloy.urlchecker.name: URLCheck
izzyondroid:com.trianguloy.urlchecker.summary: Allows analyzing (or sharing) URLs before opening them.
izzyondroid:com.trianguloy.urlchecker.description:
This application acts as an intermediary when opening url links. When you do so, a window containing information about the url is displayed, allowing you to make changes to it as well. Specially useful when you need to open an external link either from an email, a social network app or others.
 URLCheck is developed by TrianguloY, originally for personal use. It is open source (under CC BY 4.0 license), free, without any ads or trackers, light sized and using as few permissions as necessary (only the internet permission, for module checks that will only be performed when the user request them). The source code is available on GitHub too, if you want to suggest changes, perform modifications or propose a new translation: https://github.com/TrianguloY/URLCheck
 The app is structured with a modular setup, you can enable/disable and reorder individual modules, which include:
 Input text: Displays the current url which can be edited manually. Can't be disabled.
 History: View and revert any change from other modules, including edits from the user (typical undo/redo feature)
 Log: Keeps a log of all checked urls, which you can view, edit, copy, clear...
 Status code: By pressing the button a network request will be made to retrieve that url, and the status code will be displayed (ok, server error, not found...). Additionally, if it corresponds to a redirection, press the message to check the new url. The url is fetched, but not evaluated, so redirection based on javascript won't be detected.
 Url Scanner: Allows you to scan the url using VirusTotal, and check the report. A free personal VirusTotal API key is needed for it to work. VirusTotal™ is a trademark of Google, Inc.
 Url Cleaner: Uses the ClearURLs catalog to remove referral and useless parameters from the url. It also allows for common offline url redirections. Built-in catalog from https://docs.clearurls.xyz/latest/specs/rules/
 Unshortener: Uses https://unshorten.me/ to unshorten urls remotely.
 Queries remover: Displays the decoded individual url queries, which you can remove or check.
 Pattern module: Checks the url with regex patterns that warns, suggests or applies replacements. You can modify or create your own patterns, or even use user-created ones. Built-in patterns include: Warning when contains non-ascii characters like greek letters. This can be used for phishing: googĺe.com vs google.com
 Suggest replacing 'http' with 'https'
 Suggest replacing Youtube, Reddit or Twitter with privacy-friendly alternatives [disabled by default]
 Hosts checker: This module labels hosts, configured either by specifying them manually or by using a remote hosts-like file. You can use it to warn about dangerous or special sites. The builtin configuration specifies StevenBlack's hosts (adware/malware, fakenews, gambling and adult content) from https://github.com/StevenBlack/hosts
 Debug module: Displays the intent uri, and optionally info about the ctabs (custom tabs) service. This is intended for developers.
 Open module: Contains the open and share buttons. If a link can be opened with multiple apps, an arrow will be shown to let you choose. Can't be disabled.

fdroid:com.jarsilio.android.pingoff.name: PingOff
fdroid:com.jarsilio.android.pingoff.summary: Silence your phone automatically when using selected apps.
fdroid:com.jarsilio.android.pingoff.description:
PingOff is a simple app that automatically toggles Do Not Disturb based on the apps you use.
Do you like your phone quiet while reading, meditating, or playing a game? Hate getting interrupted by random notifications? Forget to turn on DND and regret it right after?
Then PingOff is the perfect app for you!
 PingOff is open source and released under the GPLv3 license[1]. Feel free to browse or fork the code[2].
 Required Android Permissions 
▸ ACCESS_NOTIFICATION_POLICY to change Do Not Disturb mode.
▸ PACKAGE_USAGE_STATS to know which app is currently running.
▸ BIND_ACCESSIBILITY_SERVICE to detect which app is in the foreground.
▸ RECEIVE_BOOT_COMPLETED to automatically start on boot if enabled.
▸ REQUEST_IGNORE_BATTERY_OPTIMIZATIONS to make sure it keeps working in the background.
 Accessibility Services 
▸ Purpose: PingOff uses the Accessibility Services API to detect which app is currently in the foreground. This lets the app automatically enable Do Not Disturb when you switch to one of your selected apps, and disable it when you leave them.
▸ Privacy and Security: The service observes only the package name of the active app. This information is used exclusively on-device to check against your personal app list. No personal data is collected, stored remotely, or shared.
▸ Permission Scope: The Accessibility Services permission is strictly used for foreground app detection. It does not read screen content, interact with other apps, or perform any other function.
 Get it 
You can download it for free from F-Droid[3].
 Translations 
Translations are always welcome! :)
The app is available for translation as two projects on Transifex[4]

fdroid:com.kylecorry.trail_sense.summary: Use your phone's sensors to assist with wilderness treks
fdroid:com.kylecorry.trail_sense.description:
Explore beyond the reaches of the Internet with Trail Sense.
 Designed for hiking, backpacking, camping, and geocaching
 Place beacons and navigate to them
 Use as a compass (only available on devices with a compass sensor)
 Follow paths
 Retrace your steps with backtrack
 Use a photo as a map
 Plan what to pack
 Be alerted before the sun sets
 Predict the weather (only available on devices with a barometer sensor)
 Use your phone as a flashlight
 And much more!
 Trail Sense is a tool, and just like any other tool that you bring into the wilderness,
it's essential to have backup equipment and skills.
This app is intended for information purposes only and the accuracy of the predictions and sensors is determined by a number of factors, including calibration, sensor quality, external sources, etc.
Use at your own risk, always have backup tools (ex. compass), and stay safe.
 This app also does not, and will never, use the Internet - all information in Trail Sense comes directly from your phone's sensors, and no data will leave Trail Sense.
 COMMON ISSUES
 No compass: If your phone does not have a compass sensor, there is nothing I can do to make it work because that is hardware.
 You will still be able to use other features of Trail Sense.
 No weather: The Weather tool is only available if your phone has a barometer sensor.
 Found an issue or want a new feature? Contact me at trailsense@protonmail.com or create a new issue on GitHub: github.com/kylecorry31/Trail-Sense
 I'm the only developer of Trail Sense, so I will do my best to help out with issues - but I have a limited device selection to test on.
 PERMISSIONS
 Notifications: Allows Trail Sense to display notifications (backtrack, weather, sunset alerts, astronomy events, water boil timer, etc)
 Location: Allows Trail Sense to retrieve your location for navigation, weather (sea level calibration), and astronomy.
 Background location: Allows Trail Sense to retrieve your location for sunset alerts while in the background.
 On some devices, this will also improve the reliability of backtrack and weather monitor.
 Physical activity: Allows Trail Sense to use your phone's pedometer for distance calculation.
 Camera: Allows Trail Sense to use your camera on the sighting compass, clinometer, and for taking photos used by the Cloud Scanner, QR Code Scanner, and Photo maps.
 Alarms & reminders: Allows Trail Sense to post a notification at an exact time.
 This is used by the Clock tool (when updating system time) and Sunset and Sunrise Alerts.
 Links
 Privacy policy: https://kylecorry.com/Trail-Sense/#privacy
 FAQ: https://github.com/kylecorry31/Trail-Sense#faq
 Trail Sense is available under the MIT License: https://opensource.org/license/mit/

fdroid:com.soul_99.suIMD.name: IMD - It's My Device (supercharged fork of Geto)
fdroid:com.soul_99.suIMD.summary: Settings manager/ hide settings from apps
fdroid:com.soul_99.suIMD.description:
IMD (It's My Device) is a powerful settings/ services manager and settings/ services hider (automated disable-enable settings) for restrictive apps (banking, payments...etc). It supports the following settings / services :
1. Developer settings
2. ADB / Debugging
3. Accessibility services
4. Display over other apps (needs active Shizuku service)
5. Shizuku service
6. and many more (per app configuration - hiding framework, hint: use Settings observer for help)
 How this works 
1. User opens app from IMD / IMD generated app shortcut
                    ↓
2. IMD actually disables these settings
 no app's security policy is broken 
                    ↓
3. Use your app normally
                    ↓
4. Use Revert function
 (accessible via: notification / quick toggle / Quick settings tile / homescreen shortcut / IMD settings manager) 
                    ↓
5. IMD enables the disabled settings
 Settings manager 
IMD's settings manager allows you to:
1. View the live status of your settings/ services
2. Quickly toggle them on-off
 Automations 
1. Auto unhide settings 
2. Auto hide settings (IMD+ : needs background service)
3. IMD Intents (Tasker / MacroDroid integration, secured with auth keys)
 About Permissions 
* WRITE_SECURE_SETTINGS (one time grant via adb shell or Shizuku) (MANDATORY, needed to change settings state)
* Shizuku service (optional) (needed to hide Display over other apps permissions - an appops permission)
* Post notifications (optional)
* Other permissions (optional: only needed if you use automations like IMD+)
 Security Concerns 
* No internet access or unnecessary continuous background services (so almost zero battery / system resource use).
* Does not tamper with any apps on the device.
* The parts of this app that change settings cannot be triggered by another app, so only you can change them.
* No ads, analytics, trackers or accounts of any kind. The app has no network permission at all - which is also why it cannot check for its own updates, and why Obtainium is how you find out there is one.
 Package: com.soul_99.suIMD - installs alongside stock Geto, both can coexist
 Requires: Android 7.0 (API 24) or newer. No root.
 Licence: GPL-3.0
Supercharged fork of Geto (https://github.com/JackEblan/Geto)

KEY FEATURES
• 13 onion search engines queried in parallel
• RAM-only session — no queries, results, or history written to disk
• Three purge triggers: panic wipe, screen lock, app exit
• Tor gate — blocks queries until a real .onion probe succeeds over Orbot SOCKS5
• Tor SOCKS5 transport with remote DNS via Tor
• FLAG_SECURE — blocks screenshots and recents thumbnails
• No backend, no telemetry, no accounts, no ads

• External link handoff to the system default browser
PRIVACY
No data collected, stored, or transmitted to any server. Queries and results exist only in RAM during the active session. Only a small set of non-sensitive settings persists across sessions (engine selection, filters, Tor endpoint, security toggles).
The app never renders remote HTML. Links open externally in the default browser via intent. Screenshots and recent-app previews are blocked.
REQUIREMENTS
• Android 7.0+ (API 24)
• Orbot running (provides the Tor SOCKS5 endpoint)
• A Tor-routed browser for opening result links (e.g. via Orbot's VPN app list)
HOW IT WORKS
1. Enter a search query
2. Ghost queries 13 onion search engines in parallel via Tor
3. Results are parsed, deduplicated, and ranked
4. Tap any result to open it in your default browser
5. When you lock the screen, exit the app, or hit panic — all session data is wiped from RAM
WHO IS THIS FOR
Ghost is built for researchers, journalists, and people who need access to information in restrictive environments. It is a tool for legitimate open-source intelligence (OSINT), investigative journalism, academic study, and censorship circumvention. The app is designed for adults who take personal responsibility for their research activities.
The developer maintains a portfolio of OSINT and security research tools. Ghost is the mobile extension of this research toolchain.
USE CASES
• Journalism and investigative research in restrictive environments
• Security research and OSINT analysis
• Academic study of onion services and censorship circumvention
• Access to information in regions with restricted internet
• Privacy education and digital rights research
OPEN SOURCE

The developer's other OSINT research projects are publicly available at:
https://codeberg.org/sookoothaii
DISCLAIMER

apple-macos:6802178400.name: AirType: Trackpad & Keyboard
apple-macos:6802178400.description:
Hold your iPhone like a mouse and turn it. The pointer on your Mac goes where you aim, because the phone is the body of the mouse.
AirType is one app in two halves, and both of them are on this listing. The iPhone half sends. The Mac half receives. You download this once and you get both, and neither half does anything on its own.
WHAT YOU DO WITH IT
Swipe to move the pointer. Tap to click. Two fingers to scroll, and it keeps rolling after you lift, with the same momentum a Mac trackpad has. Pinch to zoom. Tap the keyboard button and type with your own keyboard, emoji and all. There is a modifier row for command, control, option and shift, and a top row for volume, brightness and playback.
MOUSE MODE
Tap the mouse key and the phone becomes the mouse. Aim it at your Mac and the pointer follows your wrist, the way it follows a mouse across a desk. One finger scrolls. Tap to click, and tap the top right corner to right-click. A two finger double tap opens Mission Control. Mouse mode uses the phone's motion sensors, and the motion data stays on the phone. Tap the key again and it is a trackpad.
TRACKPAD GESTURES
The gestures your Mac's own trackpad knows. Three fingers up opens Mission Control, three fingers down shows the windows of the app in front, and three fingers sideways switches Spaces. Four fingers pinched opens Launchpad, which macOS 26 calls Apps, and four fingers spread shows the desktop. Two fingers in from the right edge opens Notification Center. A two finger double tap zooms in on what you tapped.
ABOUT THE PERMISSIONS THIS APP ASKS FOR
Three, and each one is asked for at the moment you first use the feature that needs it.
Local Network. This is how a keystroke gets from your hand to your Mac. iOS shows a dialog the first time AirType looks for your Mac on your network. AirType looks for one service, its own, and it connects to nothing else it finds.
Microphone. Only for hold to talk. It opens while your finger is down on the dictation button and closes the moment you lift it.
Speech Recognition. This is what turns what you said into the text that gets typed. It runs on this phone.
There is no account, no analytics, no advertising and no third party SDK.
THE MAC HALF COMES WITH IT
The half that runs on your Mac installs from this same App Store page, at no extra cost. It lives in the menu bar and takes about a minute to set up. There is nothing else to buy and nothing else to go find.
TRY IT WITH NO MAC AT ALL
Tap "See how it works on this phone alone" on the first screen. A cursor appears, and turning the phone moves it. The trackpad, the gestures and the keyboard all respond, and a line under the status bar reads back the exact message each one produced. It runs entirely on this phone and opens no connection at all.
SIX DIGITS, ONCE
Your Mac shows six digits. Type them once. From then on the pair finds itself: open the app and it is already connected.
WHAT IT COSTS
Everything is open for the first seven days. After that, one payment of $24.99 unlocks mouse mode, the trackpad gestures, pinch to zoom, the keyboard, the modifier row, hold to talk dictation and landscape mode, and it is the only payment there is.
Moving the pointer with a finger, clicking and scrolling are free, today and always, during the trial and after it ends. So the phone works as a trackpad for free, and the payment buys the mouse, the gestures and the keyboard.
IT WORKS AWAY FROM WI-FI
Sharing a network is faster, and AirType connects straight from this phone to your Mac when there is none to share.
NOTHING LEAVES THE TWO DEVICES
There is no server in the middle. This phone opens an encrypted link straight to your Mac and sends to nothing else it can see. A pairing code is spent the moment it is used, so a device that was never paired has no way in.
Requires macOS 13 or later on the Mac.

firefox-addons:901924.name: Open in Private Mode
firefox-addons:901924.summary: Open the active tab in a private window via toolbar button or context-menu.
firefox-addons:901924.description: Open in Private Mode is an addon that enables you to open the current tab (active) in a private window. Simply click on the toolbar button to open the private (or incognito) window. You can also use the context-menu item (right-click) to open the private window. Please note that, if you right-click on a link, the new private window will have the link URL instead of the tab. Moreover, you can use the keyboard shortcut (Alt + Shift + S) to open the active tab in a private window. If you want to open a custom URL in a private window when you click on the toolbar button, please open the options page and add a URL in the designated area. Note: after you install the addon, please head to the addon's tab, and activate the "Run in Private Windows" option. To report bugs, please fill out the bug report form on the addon's homepage.

AVG Browser Security - web reputation plugin
AVG-powered security for your Firefox browser
Browse without worry or fear with AVG in your corner: we’ll check every site you visit, from Facebook to your bank, to ensure nothing puts you or your data at risk. We stop phishing attacks, show user reviews, and warn you if a site is deemed untrustworthy by our community of 400 million.

 URL - to check if the website is safe or not

firefox-addons:2830992.summary: Browser extension for web content access for Google and YouTube by Net Protector Endpoint security.
firefox-addons:2830992.description:
Google Login controller:
This extension controls and restrict access to corporate Google accounts on endpoints, ensuring that they can only sign in to specified domains.
These domains will be authorized by their organization's security administrator using NPAV Endpoint security console.
This can be valuable for maintaining compliance and security within a corporate environment.
YouTube content manager:
This extension is used to restrict the access to YouTube videos for administrators specified categories ,channels and publishers.
These restrictions will be managed by NPAV Endpoint Security console.
features : 
Manage the Extension configuration centrally using NPAV Endpoint security.
The extension include monitoring and reporting features that allow administrators to track user activity,
identify compliance violations, and generate reports for auditing purposes.
Allows only domains authorized by organization's security administrator.
Blocking of personal user's accounts log-in.
Allows or blocks YouTube videos as per the policy assigned to endpoint by NPAV Endpoint Security Administrator
based on Video Category, Channel and Publisher.
This Extension is only be configured and used with NPAV Endpoint Security. The Endpoint does not have any option to configure and edit.
By Applying the Web content access policy this extension will install on endpoint under Extensions Mozilla Firefox browser Policy.
Browser Support : Mozilla Firefox

firefox-addons:814819.name: Simple Gesture for Android
firefox-addons:814819.summary:
Adds touch gestures for Android.
(P.S. "Quick Gestures" is great addon. I hope it be updated.)
firefox-addons:814819.description:
✨Feature 
Adds touch gestures for Android.
 📨Latest News 
In the new Firefox, swiping left or right now switches tabs.
Unfortunately, it seems add-ons can't control this behavior.
😢
 🙏Join test 
If you are willing to help test the Beta version 
 ⚠Note 
 This is an add-on for Android.
 You can install this on Windows tablets, but I have not tested it on Windows or other operating systems.
 Addons cannot work in https://*.mozilla.org etc.
 Tab gestures don't work because Firefox's API has many issues.
 👆The default gesture 
D=Down, U=Up, R=Right, L=Left
e.g.) R-U means ⤴.
 D-L: Forward
 D-R: Back
 D-R-U: Refresh
 R-D: Scroll to the top
 R-U: Scroll to the bottom
 L-D-R: Close tab
 L-D-R-U-R: Open settings pages
 🔧Custom gestures 
 https://github.com/utubo/firefox-simple_gesture/discussions/categories/customgestures 
 💡Tips 
 You can double-tap with these steps.
 1:Touch a finger.
 2:Keep the first finger and double-tap with another finger.
 If this does not work on some AMP pages, install Redirect AMP to HTML to solve the problem. ( #66 )
 Firefox for Android does not have about:home 😢.
 https://github.com/utubo/firefox-simple_gesture/issues/21 
 Other tips
 https://github.com/utubo/firefox-simple_gesture/wiki/Tips 
 🔐Permissions 
 Access recently closed tabs -> for restore closed tabs
 Access browser tabs -> for gestures to control tabs
 Access your data for all websites -> for to work on any websites
 Block content on any page -> PC site mode(User-Agent)
 Clipboard -> for custom gestues
 🐞Known Issues 
 This doesn't work on <frame> tags.
 If you try to open a new tab in private-mode, that link will be stored in the browser's history. (Firefox has a bug ) #85 
 Add-on cannot access the following information.Therefore, some tab operations may not work properly.
 Suspended tabs
 The tab order
 GitHub Issues 
 Some web APIs require a direct user interaction (such as a tap or click) to work properly. For example, navigator.share(), window.open(), and navigator.vibrate() can only be called as a result of a real user gesture.If the user moves their finger before releasing, these APIs may fail to work due to browser security restrictions to prevent unwanted popups or actions.
 🏚 For old firefox 
 If the gestures do not work when scrolling or zooming in on a page,
 open "about:config" in Firefox and set "dom.visualviewport.enabled" to "ture".
 For version 56
 The last supported version is
 https://addons.mozilla.org/android/downloads/file/3966890/simple_gesture-2.24.xpi 
 In this version, you can jump to the setting page by accessing https://example.com/simple-gesture/setting/ .
 🎂Thx 
 takachan(This add-on respects "Quick Gestures" add-on.)
 CennoxX(German translation)
 Nikitamce(Russian translation)
 OhSoGood(Double-tap idea)
 xiaoyuhaoge, Dynamith(Hint for Restore Closd Tab)
 UNTRIVAL(Hint for Kiwi)
 Wei-Winter(Hint for show the next gestures)
 fuckgfw00(Many hint for prev/next tab)
and more...
 💌p.s 
Thanks for the reviews !⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

apple-macos:6776044339.name: 941 Reps: Workout Tracker
apple-macos:6776044339.description:
New: Food. Log what you eat beside your lifts, with menus from hundreds of chains' own nutrition pages. Your first week is free; your log stays in your own iCloud.
Reps is the workout tracker for every Apple screen — iPhone, Apple Watch, iPad, Mac, and Apple TV.
Most trackers make you fight a spreadsheet mid-set. Reps keeps the workout view quiet: plan the session, log each set in two taps, and let the progression engine decide what's next.
THE PROGRESSION ENGINE
Reps ships the actual math other apps hide behind "add weight when it feels easy": double progression, effort gates, comeback ramps after time off, and stall resets after three failed sessions. You always know why the next session asks what it asks.
EVERY APPLE SCREEN
• iPhone: plan, log, review — the whole gym flow
• Apple Watch: your day's sets on your wrist, logged in a tap
• Apple TV: your session on the living-room screen while you train, plus an optional viewer for your progress photos
• iPad + Mac: review progress, adjust the plan
• Widgets: today's session at a glance
• Dynamic Island + Lock Screen: your rest timer without unlocking
PROGRESS PICS
Stand on the mark, line up with the ghost of your last photo, and a hands-free shutter takes the shot. Front, side and back, lined up month after month. Reps encrypts your photos on your iPhone and keeps the vault behind Face ID, Touch ID or your passcode. Optional sync stores them in your private iCloud database, protected by Apple's encryption: sync never sends a photo to our servers, and Reps never adds one to your Photos library on its own. Show on Apple TV puts them on an Apple TV on the same iCloud account, you against a blurred backdrop: hold Select to reveal, Back or Menu to hide. The TV cannot take photos or change your originals.
FOOD
Log what you eat beside your training. The day is four meals with a ring for what's left; the add sheet opens on the foods you eat at this hour, then search, a barcode and label scanner, and a sentence typed the way you'd say it. Restaurant menus come from the chains' own nutrition pages, searchable by chain name, with menus by country in Settings. Group a plate's parts into one dish. The Progress tab charts your weigh-ins with Apple Health's readings. A sticker on every food. Your first week of food is free to try; from there, logging is part of Reps Pro, and everything you logged stays yours in your own iCloud. Reps gives no nutrition or medical advice.
PRIVACY, PLAINLY
Your workout log is stored on your devices and can sync through your own iCloud account; progress photos sync only when you turn that on. Reps has no sign-in and no ads, and no photo ever goes to our servers. Erase all progress photos removes them from this iPhone and asks iCloud to delete its copy, once you type ERASE to confirm; if iCloud is unreachable, that part finishes when it is back.
BUILT TO STAY OUT OF YOUR WAY
• Two-tap set logging, effort ratings when you want them
• Apple Health integration — lift days in context
• Antagonist paired-set support for superset training
• No Reps account and no ads. Cloud AI planning sends training context to your selected provider when you request a plan.
FOR THE TERMINAL PEOPLE
Reps ships an MCP server and a CLI — ask your training log questions from Claude or your own tools.
REPS PRO
Your first 3 workouts and your first week of food are on us. From there, Reps Pro is one subscription for both: AI planning hosted by Reps (ask for any program; the plan adapts as you train; no API key needed) and food logging every day. Your workout log, your history and your Progress Pics stay free. US$7.99/month or US$49.99/year, local pricing shown in the app, auto-renewable. Payment charged to your Apple Account; renews unless canceled 24h before period end; manage in Account settings.
